title: 第23章 斩杀白书墨第24章 白樊得知白书墨之死
content_zh:
刘江和刘河两兄弟的表情并没有逃过郑元雪的眼睛，他们二人的表情让郑元雪确信两人肯定吸入了香气，郑元雪淡淡一笑嘴巴不停的吃着烤肉，大概是因为心情的原因手中的肉仿佛更香了一些。
“雪儿对这烤肉还算满意吗？”白书墨见郑元雪面带笑容也开口问道。
郑元雪没有立刻回答白书墨的问题而是不慌不忙的将手中的肉吃完然后起身伸了一个懒腰娇声道“嗯嗯，烤肉还是蛮好吃的！”
白书墨望着郑元雪的身姿内心欲望之火沸腾起来随后忍耐不住的开口“雪儿今天跟我回紫云城吗？”
郑元雪闻言笑了笑俏皮的开口道“抱歉白大哥，我今天就不随你去紫云城了我打算前往镇西关！”
白书墨闻言先是愣了一下他本来以为自己十拿九稳吃定郑元雪了，现在郑元雪的回答出乎意料，虽然心中恼火但还是忍住了面带笑容的开口道“雪儿你一个人在野外危险况且也没有食物什么的倒不如和我一起回紫云城，到时候我可以送你去镇西关！”
谁知白书墨的话音刚落郑元雪便笑了起来，笑了一会儿然后开口道“白大哥就放心吧我不是莽撞的人呢，我有食物喔！”
郑元雪说完从破烂的衣服里面拿出自己的空间戒指戴在手上冲白书墨挥了挥。
白书墨看到郑元雪的空间戒指明白她可能真的不缺食物，而刚刚郑元雪的落魄样子大概是装的，感觉自己被耍了的白书墨心中怒火已经浮现在了脸上，他大声的开口道“老江，老河！我希望她今天晚上跟我们回紫云城明白吗？”
“是！少爷！”刘江和刘河异口同声道，随后两人上前准备活捉郑元雪。
郑元雪见到两兄弟走到自己面前没有慌张大笑一声“怎么？不装了准备对我动手了？”
“你就是一个普通人以我们兄弟问道二阶七重的实力，两人不动用灵气就能将你擒住，识相的话就乖乖束手就擒吧！省的弄疼了你少爷也不高兴。”刘江握紧手中的铁链准备先试着说服郑元雪让她别反抗。
“哈哈哈，今天你们带不走我，相反你们都要死在这里！”郑元雪听到刘江和刘河的话大笑开口。
刘江眉头一皱盯着郑元雪，搞不懂她为什么会这么自信。
“老江，老河少废话赶快把她捉住！本少爷不打算把她带回紫云城了，现在火气很大我打算就在这里解决吧！”白书墨不耐烦的开口。
“好的！少爷！”刘江闻言答应一声也不废话给了刘河一个眼神两人握紧手中铁链开始缓缓逼近郑元雪。
郑元雪见状大笑开口“喂喂喂！还打算看戏啊，你再不出来本公主真要被活捉了！”
随着郑元雪话音刚落一把重剑飞来插在郑元雪的身前，将刘江和刘河两人的行动打断。
“怎么听你说的话，这么不相信我呢？”杨修便开口便走向郑元雪身前。
刘江看到杨修的身手知道此人肯定是修士随后疑惑开口道“此方空间已经被隔离出来，你是怎么进来的？”

“死人是不需要知道这么多的！”杨修淡淡开口。
“老江，老河你们两个还废什么话，直接将那小子杀了然后擒住那女子！”刘江还没开口，站在他们身后的白书墨便不耐烦的开口。
“少爷！这女子说她是公主！”一直沉默的刘河突然间开口道，和刘江不一样他从小就傻一些听到郑元雪说自己是公主觉得自己可能真的冒犯了皇室，反倒是杨修的出现他倒是没有在意。
“喔？”白书墨气愤的情绪因为刘河的话冷静了下来，再次仔细打量了郑元雪一番，仔细看来确实和自己在王都见过的皇室之人有几分相像，而她现在的气质和刚刚给他的感觉也不一样，现在看起来更高贵。
“你是现任皇帝的女儿？”白书墨盯着郑元雪开口问道。
白书墨的话让本来心情很好的郑元雪突然间生气了开口说道“能不能把他们都杀了？”
“好！”杨修语气当中也带着冷漠，玄水重剑也随着杨修的话落飞了起来剑指白书墨三人。
“既然没办法交流那就动手吧！”刘江不喜欢打打杀杀见杨修的行动也准备动手。
“看样子原来是前任皇帝留下的余孽！没想到现任皇帝派来的刺杀居然没有将你杀了！”白书墨看着郑元雪生气的表情心中开始暗爽起来出言嘲讽道。
刘江知道大战要开始就开始调动灵气结果发现自己的储存的灵气毫无反应便转过身小声的开口“少爷！灵气不知道什么情况，没办法调动！”
白书墨闻言脸色一变，随后看向刘河却见刘河此时也一脸茫然的看着他，知道两人的修为应该都是一样的情况，随后态度一软开口道“前几日有道士给本少爷算了一卦，说近期不能杀生，今日本少爷放你们一马！”
“噗嗤！”本来心情很差的郑元雪听到白书墨的话笑了起来。
“怎么？修为被压制开始装模作样说放我们一马？白书墨白少爷，在王都也没有听说你有这么好心的时候啊？”郑元雪调笑道。

“是你干的！”白书墨看郑元雪的表情怎么会不知道是她做的，随后收敛了笑容在储物戒中取出一枚玉符又开口“别高兴太早虽然他们两人的修为被压制了，但你以为我没有其他手段了嘛？这是我父亲亲自给我炼制的玉符，这枚玉符所凝聚的护盾你们是打不破的，而我捏碎它我父亲也会知道，没必要闹到鱼死网破的地步吧！”
“唰！”杨修没有听白书墨的废话直接出手，玄水重剑一瞬间将刘江和刘河两人头颅斩了下来。
白书墨见状直接将手中的玉符捏碎，一层灵气护盾直接将他守护在中间，杨修挥剑一剑斩在上面毫发无损，白书墨见状知道杨修不能奈何自己大笑道“你的实力看起来还不够，等我父亲拍派人来我一定要你死！”
“这玉符所化的护盾和外面那个结界是一样的！”还没等杨修思考郑元雪便开口道。
杨修闻言知道要怎么做直接斩出一道空间裂隙伸手将护盾中的白书墨拉了出来，白书墨的笑容从被杨修拉出来的一瞬间在脸上凝固了，随后焦急开口“我错了！别杀我！我可以给你好多灵石，这公主多少灵石雇佣你我给你双倍！”
“抱歉！不需要！”杨修不打算直接杀死白书墨打算折磨一下，挥剑先将白书墨双腿斩断。

“啊！为什么？我爹是白樊你想要什么我都可以给你！”白书墨被斩断双腿哀嚎一声，生的本能让他继续加筹码。
“唰！”杨修在白书墨的话说完又斩断他的双臂声音带着怒气的开口道“你记住！我叫杨修，我姓杨！总有一天我要杀了白樊！”
白书墨听到杨修的话知道杨修不可能放过自己便不再求饶大笑着开口道“哈哈哈哈！杨家人都该死！我父亲会给我报仇的，你们杨家人都……”狠话还没说完就戛然而止，玄水重剑将其头颅斩落，杨修一手握剑，一手提着白书墨头颅开口道“白家这只是一个开始！”

content_en:
The expressions of the two brothers Liu Jiang and Liu He did not escape Zheng Yuanxue's eyes. Their expressions convinced Zheng Yuanxue that they must have inhaled the aroma. Zheng Yuanxue smiled lightly and kept eating the barbecue, probably because of his mood, the meat in his hands seemed to be more fragrant.
"Are Xue'er satisfied with this barbecue?" Bai Shumo saw Zheng Yuanxue smiling and asked.
Zheng Yuanxue did not answer Bai Shumo's question immediately. Instead, she finished the meat in her hands calmly and then stood up, stretched out and said softly, "Yeah, the barbecue is quite delicious!"
Bai Shumo looked at Zheng Yuanxue's figure and the fire of desire boiled in his heart. Then he couldn't bear it and said, "Xueer, will you come back to Ziyun City with me today?"
Hearing this, Zheng Yuanxue smiled and said playfully, "Sorry, Brother Bai, I won't go with you to Ziyun City today. I plan to go to Zhenxiguan!"
Bai Shumo was stunned for a moment when he heard this. He originally thought that he was sure of defeating Zheng Yuanxue, but now Zheng Yuanxue's answer was unexpected. Although he was annoyed, he still held back a smile and said, "Xue'er, you are in danger alone in the wild and there is no food. Why don't you come back to Ziyun City with me? Then I can send you to Zhenxiguan!"
Unexpectedly, Zheng Yuanxue started laughing as soon as Bai Shumo finished speaking. After laughing for a while, he said, "Brother Bai, don't worry, I'm not a reckless person. I have food!"
After speaking, Zheng Yuanxue took out her space ring from her tattered clothes, put it on her hand and waved it to Bai Shumo.
When Bai Shumo saw Zheng Yuanxue's space ring, he understood that she might really not be short of food, and Zheng Yuanxue's depressed look just now was probably just an act. Feeling that he had been tricked, Bai Shumo's anger had already appeared on his face. He said loudly, "Lao Jiang, Lao He! I hope she will come back to Ziyun City with us tonight, do you understand?"
"Yes! Master!" Liu Jiang and Liu He said in unison, and then they stepped forward to capture Zheng Yuanxue alive.
When Zheng Yuanxue saw the two brothers walking up to her, she didn't panic and laughed, "What? Are you ready to attack me anymore?"
"You are just an ordinary person. With the strength of our brothers, the second and seventh level, the two of them can capture you without using spiritual energy. If you know what you are doing, just surrender and capture you! It will save you pain and make your young master unhappy." Liu Jiang clenched the iron chain in his hand and prepared to try to persuade Zheng Yuanxue to stop resisting.
"Hahaha, you can't take me away today. Instead, you will all die here!" Zheng Yuanxue laughed after hearing what Liu Jiang and Liu He said.
Liu Jiang frowned and stared at Zheng Yuanxue, wondering why she was so confident.
"Lao Jiang, Lao He, hurry up and catch her! I don't plan to take her back to Ziyun City. Now that I'm very angry, I plan to solve it here!" Bai Shumo said impatiently.
"Okay! Master!" Liu Jiang promised without saying a word and gave Liu He a look. The two of them clenched the chains in their hands and began to slowly approach Zheng Yuanxue.
Seeing this, Zheng Yuanxue laughed and said, "Hey, hey, hey! I'm still planning to watch a show. If you don't come out, this princess will be captured alive!"
As soon as Zheng Yuanxue finished speaking, a heavy sword flew and was inserted in front of Zheng Yuanxue, interrupting the actions of Liu Jiang and Liu He.
"Why do you not believe me so much after what you said?" Yang Xiu said and walked towards Zheng Yuanxue.
Liu Jiang saw Yang Xiu's skills and knew that this person must be a monk. Then he asked doubtfully, "This space has been isolated. How did you get in?"
"Dead people don't need to know so much!" Yang Xiu said calmly.
"Lao Jiang, Lao He, what nonsense are you two talking about? Just kill that boy and capture the woman!" Before Liu Jiang could speak, Bai Shumo, who was standing behind them, spoke impatiently.
"Master! This woman said she is a princess!" Liu He, who had been silent all this time, suddenly said. Unlike Liu Jiang, he had been a bit stupid since he was a child and heard Zheng Yuanxue say that he was a princess.He might have really offended the royal family, but on the contrary, he didn't care about Yang Xiu's appearance.
"Oh?" Bai Shumo's angry mood calmed down because of Liu He's words, and he looked at Zheng Yuanxue carefully again. It looked like she was indeed somewhat similar to the royal person he had met in the royal capital, and her current temperament was different from the one she had just given him. She looked more noble now.
"Are you the daughter of the current emperor?" Bai Shumo asked, staring at Zheng Yuanxue.
Bai Shumo's words made Zheng Yuanxue, who was in a good mood, suddenly become angry and said, "Can you kill them all?"
"Okay!" There was also indifference in Yang Xiu's tone. Following Yang Xiu's words, the Xuanshui heavy sword flew up and pointed at Bai Shumo and the others.
"Since there is no way to communicate, let's take action!" Liu Jiang didn't like the action of fighting and killing Yang Xiu and was ready to take action.
"It looks like it's a remnant left by the previous emperor! I didn't expect that the assassin sent by the current emperor didn't kill you!" Bai Shumo began to feel happy when he saw Zheng Yuanxue's angry expression and taunted him.
Knowing that the war was about to begin, Liu Jiang began to mobilize his spiritual energy. However, he found that his stored spiritual energy had no response, so he turned around and whispered, "Master! I don't know what's going on with the spiritual energy, so I can't mobilize it!"
Bai Shumo's expression changed when he heard this, and then he looked at Liu He and saw that Liu He was looking at him with a blank expression at this time. He knew that the two people's cultivation levels should be the same. Then he softened his attitude and said, "A few days ago, a Taoist priest gave me a fortune-telling and said that I can't kill in the near future. Today, I will let you go!"
"Pfft!" Zheng Yuanxue, who was originally in a bad mood, laughed when she heard Bai Shumo's words.
"What? Your cultivation has been suppressed and you are pretending to let us go? Master Bai Shu and Mo Bai, I have never heard of you being so kind in the capital?" Zheng Yuanxue teased.

"You did it!" Bai Shumo looked at Zheng Yuanxue's expression and didn't know it was her. Then he stopped smiling and took out a jade talisman from the storage ring and said again, "Don't be too happy too early. Although their cultivation has been suppressed, you can Why do I have no other means? This is the jade talisman that my father personally refined for me. You cannot break the shield condensed by this jade talisman, and if I crush it, my father will know that there is no need to cause a disaster!"
"Oh!" Yang Xiu didn't listen to Bai Shumo's nonsense and took action directly. The Xuanshui heavy sword chopped off the heads of Liu Jiang and Liu He in an instant.
When Bai Shumo saw this, he directly crushed the jade talisman in his hand. A layer of spiritual energy shield directly protected him in the middle. Yang Xiu swung his sword and slashed it with no damage. When Bai Shumo saw this, he knew that Yang Xiu could not do anything. He laughed and said, "You don't seem to be strong enough. I will kill you when my father sends someone to come!"
"The shield transformed by this jade talisman is the same as the barrier outside!" Zheng Yuanxue said before Yang Xiu could think about it.
Hearing this, Yang Xiu knew what to do and directly cut a space rift and stretched out his hand to pull out Bai Shumo from the shield. Bai Shumo's smile froze on his face from the moment he was pulled out by Yang Xiu, and then he said anxiously, "I was wrong! Don't kill me! I can give you a lot of spiritual stones. I will give you double the amount of spiritual stones this princess needs to hire you!"
"Sorry! No need!" Yang Xiu didn't intend to kill Bai Shumo directly and wanted to torture him. He swung his sword to cut off Bai Shumo's legs first.
"Ah! Why? My father is Bai Fan. I can give you whatever you want!" Bai Shumo wailed when his legs were cut off, and his raw instinct made him continue to increase his chips.
"Huh!" Yang Xiu cut off Bai Shumo's arms after what he said and said with an angry voice, "Remember! My name is Yang Xiu, and my surname is Yang! One day I will kill Bai Fan!"
Bai Shumo heard Yang Xiu's words and knew that Yang Xiu would never let him go, so he stopped begging.Rao laughed and said, "Hahahaha! The Yang family deserves to die! My father will avenge me. You Yang family all..." The cruel words stopped abruptly before he finished speaking. Xuanshui's heavy sword chopped off his head. Yang Xiu held the sword in one hand and Bai Shumo's head in the other and said, "This is just the beginning for the Bai family!"
